title: Config management plugins declared in argocd-cm stop working

detection.reason: ConfigMap KEY names are collected, never values — this rule fires on the presence of the key in the named ConfigMap

quote: Config Management Plugins installed via the argocd-cm ConfigMap will not work starting with v2.8.
remediation: Migrate every plugin in argocd-cm's `configManagementPlugins` to a sidecar plugin on the repo-server (ConfigManagementPlugin CR mounted into a sidecar) before upgrading; Applications using the old plugins fail to render afterwards.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n argocd get cm argocd-cm -o jsonpath='{.data.configManagementPlugins}' | head -c 400 # non-empty = plugins that stop working at 2.8

title: `entrypoint.sh` is gone from the 2.8 images — manifests still invoking it cannot start

detection.reason: checked in the Argo CD workloads' container command only (Deployment or StatefulSet named argocd-*)

quote: Simply updating the containers without updating the deployment manifests will result in pod startup failures, as the old manifests are relying on `entrypoint.sh` instead of `tini`. Please make sure the manifests are updated properly before moving to 2.8.
remediation: Apply the current manifests (command without `entrypoint.sh`) before or together with the 2.8 images. Bumping only the image tag on a manifest that still runs `entrypoint.sh` leaves the pod in CrashLoopBackOff.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n argocd get deploy,sts -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select([.spec.template.spec.containers[].command[]?] | any(test("entrypoint.sh"))) | .kind + " " + .metadata.name' # objects printed will fail to start on 2.8 images

title: RBAC `action/*` (or `*`) on applications now includes creating Jobs and Workflows

detection.reason: RBAC policies are the VALUE of argocd-rbac-cm's `policy.csv` key; ConfigMap values are not collected

quote: When you upgrade to 2.8, RBAC policies with `applications` in the *resource* field and `*` or `action/*` in the action field, it will automatically grant the ability to use these new actions.
remediation: Decide whether subjects holding `applications, action/*` (or `applications, *`) should be able to create a Job from a CronJob or a Workflow from a CronWorkflow/WorkflowTemplate; list explicit actions where not.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n argocd get cm argocd-rbac-cm -o jsonpath='{.data.policy\.csv}' | grep -E '^p, *[^,]+, *applications, *(\*|action/\*),' # rows printed also grant the three new actions from 2.8

title: CMP sidecars: repository files are no longer opened with executable bits

detection.reason: what a config management plugin sidecar executes from the checked-out repository is not collected

quote: In version 2.7, the CMP plugin was changed to open Git/Helm files with all executable bits set (unless `preserveFileMode` was specified). Version 2.8 removes the executable bits in cases where they are not necessary.
remediation: If a plugin sidecar runs scripts straight from the repository, set `preserveFileMode: true` in its ConfigManagementPlugin spec or invoke the interpreter explicitly.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n argocd get deploy argocd-repo-server -o json | jq -r '.spec.template.spec.containers[1:][].name' # names printed are CMP sidecars — check whether they execute repository files directly
